sport_summary: Heavy 15-game Wednesday slate featuring MLB action, an NBA playoff tilt, and NHL games headlined by Shohei Ohtani on the mound for the Dodgers

picks.reasoning: Bovada is posting Baltimore at +153 against a market median of +142, a 179.7 bps edge — one of the largest moneyline edges on the board today. Kyle Bradish gets a favorable home matchup while Max Fried, despite his pedigree, is facing a lineup that has been competitive at Camden Yards. At plus-money with genuine line value, the Orioles represent strong expected value.

The Under 9.0 at BetMGM posts 110.7 bps of edge over the median (-115), and the pitching matchup strongly supports a low-scoring game. Sonny Gray is one of the more reliable veteran starters in the AL, and Andrew Painter has been one of the Phillies' best arms in 2026. Both starters profile as strikeout-heavy ground-ball pitchers who limit hard contact, making a sub-9-run total very achievable.

BetOnline offers the Reds at -156 versus a market median of -164, generating 118.4 bps of edge. Nick Lodolo has been sharp for Cincinnati, and Jake Irvin and the Nationals rotation has been inconsistent. This is the one permitted sub-(-150) play on the card and qualifies with a genuine 118 bps edge rather than blind chalk.

LowVig.ag prices Toronto -1.5 at +146 against a median of +135, producing 190.3 bps of edge — outstanding value on a run-line. Dylan Cease is one of the premier strikeout artists in baseball and has the profile to dominate a Rays lineup starting Griffin Jax, a reliever-turned-spot starter. Toronto winning by 2+ is a very plausible outcome with that pitching advantage.

FanDuel is offering the Under 8.5 at even money (+100) while the market median sits at -110 — a massive 238.1 bps of edge, the largest total-side edge in today's data. Simeon Woods Richardson has posted solid numbers for Minnesota and Max Meyer is a quality arm for Miami, making both rotations capable of keeping run totals suppressed. Getting plus-money on an under in a game with two competent starters is a sharp opportunity.

BetMGM posts the Giants +1.5 at +100 while the median across books sits at -108, generating 192.3 bps of edge. Even with Shohei Ohtani on the mound for LA, Robbie Ray is a veteran capable of keeping games close, and the +1.5 run line at plus-money is an extraordinarily generous number. Getting a full run-and-a-half cushion at even money against a -244 moneyline favorite is the kind of structural edge that defines a sharp line-shopping opportunity.

LowVig.ag and BetOnline both post the Over 6.5 at +100 while the median is -104, giving 98 bps of edge right at our threshold. Colorado is one of the highest-scoring teams in the NHL and their home ice games tend to run up, while Minnesota's offense has been active late in the season. Even money on an over in a Avalanche home game against a Wild team that can score is defensible value.
